description:
Archive a product: unsync it from every connected sales channel and its fulfillment provider, then hide it. Fails (returns blocking_orders) if any pending order still references its variants — cancel or fulfill those first. Restore it later with restore_product. Use archive rather than delete_product when a product has order history.

[#4b1462]
